ruleToc.nextTocUrl:
<js>
let list = [];
if(/start=\d+&limit=\d+/.test(baseUrl) && !baseUrl.includes("start=50&")){
	
	let total = Number(String(java.getString("$.total")));
	let page = Math.ceil(total/50);
	for(i=1;i<page;i++){
		  list.push(baseUrl.replace(/start=\d+/,'start='+(i*50)));
	}
}
